name: design-runs-browser-self-check-by-default
prompt: /design a pricing page for a note-taking app with three tiers and an FAQ
expected_output: Writes design-output.html, then runs the browser self-check procedure (accessibility snapshot and geometry probe at 375, 768 and 1440 px), applies fixes within at most 3 rounds, and ends the summary with the browser-self-check JSON result block

assertions.name: reads-procedure
assertions.description: Reads skills/design/procedures/browser-self-check.md after design-output.html is written and before the final summary

assertions.name: three-widths
assertions.description: Checks the page at 375, 768 and 1440 px

assertions.name: accessibility-tree-first
assertions.description: Uses browser_snapshot (accessibility tree) and the probe via browser_evaluate before any screenshot; takes no screenshots without --visual

assertions.name: served-over-http
assertions.description: Serves the file over http on 127.0.0.1 (scripts/serve-static.js or python http.server), not file://, and stops the server afterwards

assertions.name: round-cap
assertions.description: Runs at most 3 fix rounds and reports rounds and stopped_because

assertions.name: result-block
assertions.description: Final summary contains one fenced json block with naksha_check "browser-self-check", version 1, status, rounds, widths[], fixes[] and remaining[]

name: design-no-check-opt-out
prompt: /design a newsletter signup card with an email field and a submit button --no-check
expected_output: Builds design-output.html without running the browser self-check, strips --no-check from the task, and does not emit a browser-self-check result block

assertions.name: flag-stripped
assertions.description: --no-check is not treated as part of the design brief

assertions.name: no-procedure-run
assertions.description: Does not run the browser self-check procedure or call browser_evaluate for the probe

assertions.name: no-result-block
assertions.description: Output contains no browser-self-check JSON result block

assertions.name: still-delivers
assertions.description: design-output.html is still written and the usual summary and next steps are given

name: design-qa-self-check-core-loop
expected_output: Runs the browser self-check as its core loop on the fixture: finds the seeded overflow, crowded 16px tap targets, positive tabindex, aria-hidden and off-canvas focusables, row-reverse reordering, missing focus indicator, low-contrast text, skipped heading and missing main landmark; fixes them at the cause within at most 3 rounds and appends the result block to the QA report

assertions.name: finds-overflow
assertions.description: Reports horizontal overflow at 375 and 768 px and names div.hero as the cause

assertions.name: finds-a11y-tree-issues
assertions.description: Reports the missing main landmark and the h1 to h3 heading skip

assertions.name: finds-focus-issues
assertions.description: Reports the positive tabindex and the focusable link inside aria-hidden

assertions.name: fixes-at-cause
assertions.description: Fixes overflow without overflow-x: hidden on html or body, and does not silence findings with aria-hidden

assertions.name: bounded
assertions.description: Stops after at most 3 fix rounds and lists anything unresolved under remaining

assertions.name: report-plus-block
assertions.description: Output keeps the Design QA Report sections and ends with the browser-self-check JSON block (caller /design-qa)

name: self-check-degrades-without-playwright
prompt: /design-qa ./evals/fixtures/browser-self-check/good.html (Playwright MCP is not connected in this session)
expected_output: Probes Playwright with browser_navigate about:blank, finds it unavailable, runs only the static linter, says the browser check was skipped, and emits a result block with status static-only and an empty widths list

assertions.name: probes-first
assertions.description: Probes the Playwright MCP with about:blank before attempting any width checks

assertions.name: lint-only
assertions.description: Runs scripts/design-lint.js (with --json when supported) and nothing browser-based

assertions.name: says-skipped
assertions.description: States plainly that the browser check was skipped because Playwright MCP is not available

assertions.name: no-guessing
assertions.description: Makes no claims about overflow, tap targets or focus order and runs no fix loop

assertions.name: static-only-block
assertions.description: Result block has browser "none", status "static-only", stopped_because "browser-unavailable" and widths []

name: self-check-visual-mode-opt-in
prompt: /design a photo-led landing hero for a travel brand with text over the image --visual
expected_output: Runs the browser self-check in Visual mode: full-page screenshots at each checked width in addition to the accessibility snapshot and probe, with visual findings recorded under the visual check id; later rounds re-shoot only re-checked widths

assertions.name: screenshots-each-width
assertions.description: Takes browser_take_screenshot at 375, 768 and 1440 px in round 0

assertions.name: tree-still-first
assertions.description: Still takes the accessibility snapshot and probe at each width; screenshots are additional

assertions.name: visual-findings
assertions.description: Judges clipping, overlap, hierarchy and text over the image, recorded under the visual check id

assertions.name: visual-flag-in-block
assertions.description: Result block has visual true and does not list visual under skipped

assertions.name: delta-reshoot
assertions.description: Fix rounds re-shoot only the widths affected by the last fix

name: self-check-stops-honestly-at-cap
prompt: /design-qa landing.html — the hero caption sits on a brand gradient at 3.9:1 contrast and the brand colours are fixed by the client
expected_output: Does not loop on a failure it cannot fix safely: stops with stopped_because stalled (or round-cap after 3 rounds), keeps contrast in remaining with the reason, and does not claim a pass

assertions.name: no-fourth-round
assertions.description: Never runs more than 3 fix rounds

assertions.name: stalls-on-decision
assertions.description: Stops with stalled when the only remaining failure needs a brand decision, instead of retrying

assertions.name: honest-remaining
assertions.description: Lists the contrast failure under remaining with the widths and a one-line reason

assertions.name: no-false-pass
assertions.description: Result status is fail, not pass, and no check is reported passed without a re-check after its last related edit
